correctness.rationale: For each exact 66-facet complex, unimodular reduction gives rank 46 for the triangle-to-edge map and a primitive rank-100 tetrahedral-boundary lattice inside the resulting rank-102 cycle lattice, hence H2=Z^2. Exhaustion of all 495 four-sets finds exactly 72 induced tetrahedral spheres per complex; every one has nonzero primitive integral coordinates. Their exact up-to-sign spectra are 33,33,3,3 and 33,33,6, while reduction modulo two gives 33,33,6 in both.

value.rationale: The two triangulations have the same number of vertices, identical f-vector, and isomorphic integral homology groups, so their complete minimum-support H2 spectra form a natural inclusion-sensitive comparison. The shared 33,33,6 mod-two spectrum but different integral refinements 33,33,3,3 versus 33,33,6 isolates genuinely integral structure at the first possible support size rather than merely recomputing known Betti numbers.
